title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the counter's calling board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Papan Panggil
options.lineage: Indonesian public-service queue boards — bank and puskesmas nomor antrean panels
options.thesis: The counter's calling board: the renter in front of you is the called number.
options.viewport: A dark calling rail over one huge called number, the day's queue numbered beneath it.
options.risk: A loud called number reads as a departure board if the real work is not one tap away.

raised.raise: The called number is a living instrument: one variable condensed face whose weight and tracking follow queue pressure through a single custom property.
Glance density: the Sepeda tab indexes every bike on one screen, each with a status band, never a table.
Catalog spine: the asset tag JMB-###-XXX-### never truncates and carries the bike's state as a coded band.

options.label: Kartu Stok
options.lineage: gudang stock cards — the shelf card that carries a running balance
options.thesis: Every movement gets a row, and the balance is always the last word.
options.viewport: A header block of fixed fields over five ruled columns with Sisa boxed at the right.
options.risk: Most runs in this category already land on a clean list of rows.

options.label: Tabbed Manual Board
options.lineage: boxed-software manuals — acetate leaves over a coloured divider board
options.thesis: Today's handovers as hinged leaves over one coloured divider, ranked by ply.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail down the fore edge with the called job on the top clear leaf.
options.case: The strongest working-board fusion: ply, hinge and a vermilion errata slip give a real state language, and a Jambi counter would read it at once — but the tab rail and leaves are the world supplying layout, which caps clarity on a working screen.
options.risk: The tab rail and hinged leaves are the world supplying layout, which caps clarity.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.lineage: the consumer app canon — warm ground, white cards, one action colour
options.thesis: The counter as a friendly app: plain words, soft cards, one pressable colour.
options.viewport: One scrolling column of cards with a thumb-reachable bar pinned below.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and is the safest read for hurried, gloved hands — it wins on familiarity and loses the counter its identity.
options.risk: It is the shape every app in this category already ships.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: 1960s airline ticket wallets — carbon coupons, official colour, tear-off stubs
options.thesis: One handover as a coupon book: each leg tears off, nothing disappears, it cancels.
options.viewport: Tabbed coupon heads ruled in hairlines, carbon numerals striking fixed fields.
options.case: Maps the sequence and the flag-never-drop rule better than anything else in the hand — a leg per sheet, a stamp instead of a deletion — but its carrier livery is nostalgia this outlet never knew.
options.risk: Carrier livery is nostalgia this outlet never knew.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.lineage: interactive type specimens — one axis slider morphing a whole glyph grid
options.thesis: Every figure on the counter as one flexible number you reshape live.
options.viewport: One enormous figure over a grid of glyphs and a monospace axis readout.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no counter staffer identifies with a type foundry specimen.
options.risk: Reads as a foundry demo, not a counter.
options.kept: The numeral as a living instrument — a figure that responds continuously instead of sitting static.

options.label: Title Card Wall
options.lineage: streaming catalogs — horizontally scrolling rows of poster tiles
options.thesis: The outlet's bikes as a wall of tiles, the focused one expanding to tell you what it is.
options.viewport: Rows of fixed-ratio tiles under row headings, the focused tile lifting.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the wall supplies the page's organisation, which an Operate surface cannot take, and state hides behind focus.
options.kept: Glance density — one screen that indexes every object with a face and a status band.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.lineage: factory record sleeves — fac numbers, colour codes, one white pulse plot
options.thesis: Every bike a catalog entry, its state a strip of colour blocks instead of words.
options.viewport: Vast unprinted black with one white pulse plot and a small catalog number.
options.case: Fuses poorly: nobody at the outlet identifies with Manchester sleeve design, and decoding colour strips hides the words a hurried staffer needs.
options.risk: Identity that belongs to another city and decade.
options.kept: The catalog-number spine — one canonical code set at full size, state as a coded band.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The working scanner app this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A large camera panel over a filterable list of the outlet's bikes.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
